_comment: Owner-approved dependency-audit exceptions for the DEVELOPMENT tree only (decision 38); a production high or critical finding can never be excepted. Each entry: package, optional advisory (GHSA id), reason, added and expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 30 days apart). An expired or malformed entry FAILS the gate.

exceptions.reason: Development tree only (eslint-config-next, a lint-time tool; nothing ships). The advisory is a stack-exhaustion denial of service on deeply nested brace patterns in braces, and no fixed braces release exists (npm audit offers only a downgrade to eslint-config-next 14). Added by the build agent in M8 T17 so CI can pass; the Owner reviews it at the M8 review point and it expires in 30 days.
